subject.title: chore: align iOS icons with favicon mark

question: Should this PR preserve a distinct iOS/watchOS Debug icon treatment before merge, or intentionally remove that build-identity distinction?
rationale: Current main and recent merged PRs rely on `AppIconDebug` being visually distinct after the Debug display name was changed to `OpenClaw`, but this PR makes Debug and Release icon assets identical.

options.title: Preserve Debug identity
options.body: Regenerate Debug catalogs from the new mark while keeping a visible debug/construction treatment before merge.

options.title: Limit this PR to release icons
options.body: Drop the Debug catalog changes here and handle the Debug refresh separately with explicit proof.

options.title: Accept identical icons
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally remove the visual Debug distinction, but that product choice should be explicit.

recommendation.title: Preserve Debug identity
recommendation.body: Regenerate Debug catalogs from the new mark while keeping a visible debug/construction treatment before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored and merged the recent Debug build identity policy that depends on icon distinction.
